name: claude_p11_follow_dispatch_overflow (B10/B11 Follow dispatcher: full NPC bag leaves the overflow in the source; DEBUG rbp11 hook; NOT RUN)
classification: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT; needs the DEBUG rbp11 hook and a CodexTest save. Asserts the Follow dispatcher (RebirthP11FollowLootDispatcher.Tick) commits exactly one leg into the single free cell and keeps the remainder in the source, by [RBP11] mark/conserve/receipts lines (positive expectLog only).
_fixture: SAVE: authoritative disposable save named CodexTest, Smart Looting option ON.

NPC: hired human NPC in Follow order standing within 3 m of container C; its bag has exactly ONE free cell, every other cell filled with an unrelated non-stackable item. Replace NPCID by its entity id.

C (CX CY CZ): already-touched container holding 3 different non-stackable stacks (A, B, C). S (SX SY SZ): owner storage with free cells that must stay untouched. Tokens are non-numeric on purpose: an unedited file fails loudly.
_limits: Overflow-to-owner-storage routing does not exist in production (the remainder stays in the container); S is only watched for an unchanged total.
Totals are by item name, not exact frames.

steps._note: Baselines first: the dispatcher acts only after the gates are armed, so mark before arming.
Bag full: exactly one leg committed; the other two stacks are still in the source. Whole payload conserved across container + bag delta + storage delta.

steps.console: rbp11 conserve source0 grid:CX:CY:CZ bag:NPCID:bag0 grid:SX:SY:SZ:storage0

steps._note: No additional legs after the bag is full (cooldown, no re-scan spam, no storage fallback): a second wait leaves the totals unchanged.

steps.console: rbp11 conserve source0 grid:CX:CY:CZ bag:NPCID:bag0 grid:SX:SY:SZ:storage0
